one_line: Title cards appear on a dark background showing production credits.
A young man and woman stand on an arched canal bridge, interacting as she gestures with a robotic arm.
A young couple interacts on a bridge before the scene transitions forty years later to a ruined industrial setting.
Scientists operate laboratory equipment overlaid with digital graphics before a model brain appears.
A man with a mechanical eyepiece examines a model brain surrounded by glowing light arcs.
Title card displaying "Tears of Steel" appears on a dark background followed by a wide shot of a futuristic city skyline.
A large flying vehicle hovers over a town as a person aims a rifle with a scope.
Three characters walk away on a city street, and one of them undergoes a digital transformation.
A young man stands beside a large robotic structure on a bridge before the scene shifts to a man working at a futuristic digital console.
A mechanical humanoid figure scrambles across rooftops in a historic city.
A man with a cybernetic eye and a woman watch a mechanical hand interact with a young man's face outdoors.
A man looks shocked as a device errors during playback.
An elderly man with white hair stands on a platform, gently touching the metallic head of a large robot.
An older man with white hair and a beard examines a large robotic structure before a close-up of another man with a cybernetic eye.
A close-up shot of a man with a mechanical eye device talking and gesturing in an interior setting.
An elderly man stands in a cavernous industrial space beside a large robotic machine.
